expo.name: Every Bible
expo.description: Every Bible helps people read, listen to, and share Scripture together in multiple languages, with offline access and simple group discipleship tools.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Every Bible to record audio responses for chapter feedback.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Every Bible to access your camera if you choose to take a profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Every Bible to access your photo library so you can choose a profile photo.
